verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a public REST Cloud API, backed by a published OpenAPI spec at cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json and an API reference at docs-api.lambda.ai. The docs show it launching instances programmatically, applying cloud-init, choosing base images and managing workspaces. A community developer built a CLI and MCP server on top of it so AI agents can launch and terminate instances, which independently corroborates the API. The probe 404s only show the spec isn't at the docs.lambda.ai paths, not that the API is missing. Missing for 10: evidence that the API covers 1-Click Cluster reservation and managed Kubernetes/Slurm resources (the docs describe 1CC reservation as console-driven).
